Cases are disjoint and exhaustive, proving the full all-weight polynomial, and its unique weight-two term is the hub label two. Independently enumerated every feasible original-neighborhood label assignment for blade size tuples (2,2),(2,3),(3,3),(2,2,2); all coefficient arrays matched. Finite tests corroborate the arbitrary-r, arbitrary-m_i proof.
